summary: Keep which claim replaced each repaired original after its wire record is trimmed

replay.detail: No replay. A one-time copy at open reads only the repaired records, through the existing replica_records_repaired_claim partial index, and records completion in meta.

schema.detail: Adds the WITHOUT ROWID table repaired_claim_replacements(claim_id, replacement_claim_id, record_ref), one row per repaired original claim, and two triggers on replica_records (AFTER INSERT and AFTER UPDATE OF state, claim_id, replacement_claim_id, when the record is repaired). Rows are never deleted. Storage version stays 20; earlier binaries keep the triggers firing, which is harmless.

rules.detail: Nothing reads the new table yet; exclusion readers and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No wire, client or backup format change.

downtime.detail: Normal restart. The one-time copy is bounded by the number of repaired records.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an earlier binary is supported; the table and triggers remain and nothing depends on them.
